name: Afluente Transmissao de Energia Eletrica S.A.
summary: Afluente Transmissão de Energia Elétrica S.A. operates transmission lines and sub-stations in Bahia, Brazil. It operates nine transmission lines with approximately 450 kilometers; and three sub-stations located in Feira de Santana, Brumado, and Itagibá. The company was formerly known as Imanisse Participações S.A. and changed its name to Afluente Transmissão de Energia Elétrica S.A. in September 2009. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Afluente Transmissão de Energia Elétrica S.A. is a subsidiary of Neoenergia S.A.
